name: Mailspring
description: The source supports a narrow primary C observation for Mailspring: its feed is HTTPS, but the feed response may nominate either HTTP or HTTPS and the in-repo code does not verify the payload. Windows verification/install is delegated to Squirrel Update.exe; macOS delegates to Electron autoUpdater, so the complete artifact-verification boundary is external to this checkout.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
Squirrel.Windows, Squirrel.Mac/Electron, and the update service are external components; their artifact-signing behavior was not established here.
The Linux implementation only opens the nominated URL and does not establish automatic replacement.
